Subject: Welcome to Northbay — Meet the Trailwool Sock
Preview: Three pairs of merino wool blend socks, built for the trail.
Body: Welcome to Northbay.

We're a small crew of people who spend a lot of time outside and make gear that holds up out there. No fuss, no noise — just things that work.

You've got trips planned. Maybe a long weekend on a ridge trail, a shoulder-season thru-hike section, or just the kind of mileage that asks a lot of your feet. That's where the Trailwool Sock comes in.

The Northbay Trailwool Sock (NB-SOK-11) is a merino wool blend sock. Merino regulates temperature across a range of conditions, resists odor over multi-day use, and moves moisture without the synthetic scratch. It's a good sock for moving through variable weather on foot.

Each pack includes three pairs — enough to rotate through a typical trip without doing laundry every night.

These aren't built for extreme mountaineering or technical crampon use. They're a solid everyday trail sock for the kind of hiking most of us actually do.

If that's your kind of trip, they're worth a look.
